title: Cloud-to-cloud messages move to the mailbox
why: A delivered send_message is not a read and leaves no copy, so cloud-to-cloud messages can be lost with no trace.
note: Owner ruling, typed in chat to the session-messaging topic session at 09:33 CST Nov 10 (relayed 09:34 CST; page item 482, closed): every message goes through the git mailbox, cloud to cloud included ("everything on one side"); it replaces decision session-messages' line "Cloud to cloud keeps send_message". Cloud send_message stays only as a short "check your mail" doorbell, so an idle session wakes. Work: record the ruling in decision session-messages; mail send also sends the doorbell; the waiting-page skill drops the cloud send_message route. Blocked: the freeze (owner 09:18 CST Nov 10) holds new lanes, and the decision text lands after #2544 (session-messages Q4 answered, docs only) merges. Open, not yet asked: which send_message problems the owner saw. The messaging session lands the ruling in decision session-messages on branch mailbox-one-route, a docs PR ( CST); the build half still waits for the freeze. The design must not depend on the device (owner 09:34 CST, page item 483).
